title: Document a bounded maintenance workflow
prompt: In the current Seloryn checkout, document and wire a bounded maintenance workflow from the task fixture: one discoverable command path, one deterministic acceptance command, an explicit rollback or failure boundary, and a user-facing limit statement. Do not claim a release, stable ABI or unsupported platform. Do not change VERSION.toml, publish, or use the network. Emit only the observable acceptance fields in the task-named adapter file.
